content:
The test image shows a young soybean seedling that has collapsed at the soil line. Key observations:
- Very early growth stage (cotyledon stage)
- Brown, thin, rotted hypocotyl
- Wilted, brown/tan cotyledons
- Wet, dark soil
- Plant appears to have fallen over/collapsed

This is classic damping-off symptomology. The Pythium reference images show nearly identical seedlings with brown rotted stems at soil level on wet soil. Rhizoctonia and Phytophthora affect more mature plants. Fusarium and Charcoal Rot also show mature plant symptoms. Anthracnose affects pods/leaves.
